title: Privacy information
description: Privacy information for TraduXpress is being prepared.
body:
## Privacy information in preparation

TraduXpress is preparing privacy information that accurately reflects its services, website tools, and applicable requirements. The details have not yet been confirmed, so this page does not make claims about how personal information is collected, used, or stored.

There is currently no contact form on this page. Until the privacy information and contact channels are published, please do not submit personal or confidential information through the website.
